title: Freeman Dyson on the Global Warming Hysteria April, 2015
summary: A 2015 interview in which physicist Freeman Dyson, then 91, argues that global warming concerns are exaggerated, that CO2 is beneficial and that climate models oversimplify complex systems. It is posted on a channel that opposes climate consensus.
why: HN commenters point to it as a prominent physicist's skeptical counter-view, usually when someone asks for dissenting opinions.

quote.text: He explains his position quite coherently
